description: Kelly Weill traces the Flat Earth movement from the 1830s to its online revival and connections with other conspiracy beliefs.

description: After her twin sister is murdered in Sicily, a young witch pursues revenge, risking the forbidden magic her family has taught her to avoid.

title: Assembly
description: A Black British woman prepares for a garden party at her boyfriend's family estate, questioning the life she has so carefully put together.

title: Happy Hour
description: Isa and Gala hustle through a hot New York summer, relying on charm and new friends to keep going as their money runs short.

title: Interview With the Vampire
description: A vampire looks back over two centuries, recounting the deaths, attachments, and hunger that have made his long life a torment.

description: In 1988, Frank still sells vinyl and finds the right music for lonely customers. A mysterious visitor disturbs the life he has built around his shop.

description: Katrina's anxious rituals and fixation on a coworker keep her life in order, until a cryptic message suggests he knows she has been watching him.

title: Invisible Women

description: Drawing on her path from Morocco to US citizenship, Laila Lalami asks why legal belonging does not give every American the same security or freedom.

description: Abby hopes to build a happier family with her husband, but the vengeful ghost of her mother-in-law threatens to keep them trapped in the past.

title: The Shining Girls
description: A killer uses a house to travel through time and murder young women. When Kirby survives his attack, she begins hunting him across the gaps.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: A snowdrift strands the Orient Express after a passenger is murdered in a locked compartment, leaving Poirot to investigate everyone still aboard.

title: The World Keeps Ending, and the World Goes on
description: Franny Choi's poems move between wartime Korea, the climate crisis, and imagined futures, asking what survival means after a world has already ended.

title: Dream States
description: John Lorinc asks who benefits from smart cities when private technology, surveillance, and automation govern more of urban life.

title: Bliss Montage
description: Eight stories turn familiar lives strange, introducing an invisibility drug, a house of ex-boyfriends, and a burial ritual that heals.

title: The Family Game
description: Novelist Harry meets her fiance's wealthy family, discovering that joining them means taking part in dangerous traditions.

title: Our Missing Hearts
description: A cryptic letter sends Bird looking for his missing mother in an America that bans books and takes children from dissidents.

title: The Manhattan Girls
description: Dorothy Parker and three friends meet over bridge in 1920s New York, helping one another through romantic and professional setbacks between cocktails.

title: Girls With Bright Futures
description: Three mothers vie for one Stanford recommendation for their daughters, until an attack turns their rivalry into a police case.

title: In Sensorium
description: Tanaïs uses scent and childhood memory to revisit South Asian history, tracing caste, gender, war, and the trauma passed through their family.

title: The Bell Jar
description: Esther Greenwood appears talented and successful, but her carefully promising life begins to collapse as she struggles with a worsening mental illness.

title: Norwegian Wood
description: Tokyo student Toru loves Naoko, with whom he shares an old grief, but finds himself drawn to another woman as Naoko retreats from the world.

title: The King of Infinite Space
description: A philosopher, his friend Horatio, and his artist ex-fiancee face strange events after his father's death in this Hamlet retelling set in New York.

title: One Two Three
description: Teenage triplets take up their mother's fight against the chemical company that poisoned their town when its plans to reopen threaten everything again.

title: Pedro Páramo
description: Keeping a promise to his dying mother, a man goes to Comala to find his absent father, only to encounter a town crowded with ghosts and memories.

title: Piranesi
description: Piranesi explores an immense house of statues and flooded halls, charting its tides and rooms as if the building were the whole world.

title: Book Lovers
description: Holidaying in a small town, literary agent Nora keeps running into a prickly editor from home, making their rivalry harder to sustain.

title: The Razor's Edge
description: Larry Darrell pursues spiritual answers while the people around him choose between love, wealth, and social standing.

title: When the Reckoning Comes
description: Mira returns for a friend's plantation wedding, facing old attachments and the spirits of enslaved people said to haunt the grounds.

title: The Escape Room
description: Four ambitious Wall Street colleagues enter a locked elevator for a team-building escape game, where the stakes become much higher than their careers.

title: The Jasmine Throne
description: A princess imprisoned in a temple allies with a servant hiding forbidden magic, drawing both into a struggle for their empire.

title: Why Fish Don't Exist
description: Lulu Miller follows a scientist's drive to classify fish after an earthquake destroys his collection, questioning what his search for order leaves out.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
description: Generations of the Buendia family live through the rise and decline of a small South American town, sharing its changing fortunes.

title: Of Blood and Sweat
description: Clyde W. Ford follows individual Black lives to show how their work built the wealth, power, and institutions of the United States.

title: That Time I Loved You

description: Essays, history, and poetry retell America's origins through slavery and Black lives, tracing their influence into the present.

title: The Stationery Shop
description: Separated on the eve of marriage during Iran's 1953 coup, a couple meet again in America sixty years later to learn what kept them apart.

title: The Upper World
description: An accident lets Esso glimpse the past and future. What he sees gives him little time to work out whether he can change what is coming.

title: Gods of Jade and Shadow
description: Casiopea dreams of leaving her grandfather's household, until the Mayan god of death draws her into a dangerous journey.

title: A Man Called Ove
description: Ove guards his routines and keeps his neighbors at a distance, until a talkative family moves in next door and begins wearing down his defenses.

title: The Oracle of Night
description: Sidarta Ribeiro asks why humans dream, bringing neuroscience together with the history of dreams in religion and literature.

title: Atlas Shrugged
description: The decisions of a handful of industrial leaders unsettle the capitalist world, making their work, independence, and ambitions a public battleground.

title: The Song of Achilles
description: Patroclus follows Achilles to Troy, where their bond faces the demands of war and the fate waiting for the celebrated young warrior.

title: Truly Devious
description: Arriving at a Vermont boarding school, amateur detective Stevie Bell sets out to solve the decades-old disappearance of its founder's wife and daughter.

title: A Woman of No Importance
description: Rejected by the foreign service, Virginia Hall becomes a secret agent in occupied France, building a resistance network while evading the Germans.

title: Caste
description: Isabel Wilkerson compares American racial hierarchy with caste in India and Nazi Germany, examining the rules that determine who holds power.

title: A Divine Language
description: Returning to mathematics at midlife, Alec Wilkinson works through its mysteries and asks what learning them might change.

title: On Earth We're Briefly Gorgeous
description: Little Dog writes to his mother, who cannot read, piecing together their Vietnamese family's history and parts of his life he has never shared.

title: Code Girls
description: Thousands of American women become wartime codebreakers, taking on secret work and entering careers previously closed to them.

title: Terms and Conditions
description: To meet the terms of his inheritance, Declan agrees to marry his assistant and have an heir. Acting like a couple starts to complicate their contract.

title: The Fine Print
description: Renovating a theme park could secure Rowan's inheritance, but hiring Zahra leads to a kiss and a secret identity that make the job personal.

title: Ten Tomatoes That Changed the World
description: William Alexander follows the tomato from feared oddity to everyday staple, tracing the growers, appetites, and industrial practices behind its success.

title: The Indisputable Existence of Santa Claus
description: Hannah Fry and Thomas Oléron Evans tackle Christmas with mathematics, using equations and diagrams to explain festive puzzles.

title: The Name of This Book Is Secret
description: Two eleven-year-old outsiders investigate a dead magician, trying to stop a sinister pair from finding the secret of eternal life.

title: An Imaginary Tale
description: Paul Nahin traces the square root of minus one through two millennia of mathematical puzzles, arguments, and eventual practical uses.

title: Mathematics for Human Flourishing
description: Francis Su connects mathematics with the human needs to create and understand, arguing that its pleasures should belong to everyone.

title: White Elephant
description: During India's 1878 famine, an Irish policeman and an activist investigate two laborers' murders amid caste and colonial violence.

title: There Is No Antimemetics Division
description: A secret division faces entities that erase awareness of themselves. Fighting them means trying to remember an enemy designed to be forgotten.

title: We Burned So Bright
description: With a black hole a month away from Earth, husbands Don and Rodney drive from Maine to Washington to finish something they cannot leave undone.

title: The Anthropologists
description: Asya and Manu look for an apartment in a foreign city, trying to decide what their shared life, rituals, and chosen family might become.

title: The Quantum and the Lotus
description: A Buddhist monk and an astrophysicist compare their paths through science and Buddhism, asking how each understands reality.

title: Slaughterhouse-five, Or, The Children's Crusade
description: After returning from World War II, Billy Pilgrim is taken by aliens who experience time differently, upending his understanding of his own life.

title: Crime and Punishment
description: An impoverished student murders a pawnbroker to test his belief that exceptional people stand above the law, then struggles under guilt and fear.

title: The Glass Bead Game
description: Raised among an intellectual elite, Joseph Knecht devotes his life to mastering a game that brings music, mathematics, and philosophy together.

title: Mark Z. Danielewski's House of Leaves
description: A family's new home proves larger inside than outside, drawing its inhabitants into an impossible space that resists explanation.

title: On Photography
description: Susan Sontag considers the meaning and authority of photographs in six essays about encountering the world through images.

title: Vile Bodies
description: A struggling writer and an aristocratic young woman chase pleasure through 1920s London, where glittering parties do little to secure their futures.

title: A Canticle for Leibowitz
description: Centuries after nuclear war destroys civilization, a religious order preserves the fragments of knowledge that a violently anti-learning world rejects.

title: Hotel
description: A. K. Sandoval-Strausz follows the American hotel's rise, tracing how its buildings and guests changed travel and public life.

title: Provenance
description: John Drewe recruits a struggling painter to create forgeries, then manipulates their histories so the art world will accept them as genuine.

title: How Music Works
description: Scientist and musician John Powell explains harmony, timbre, and chords, connecting the sounds we hear to the physics behind them.

title: Midnight Riot
description: Investigating London murders draws police recruit Peter Grant into magic, rival river gods, and a threat rooted in the city's past.

title: Walkable City
description: Urban planner Jeff Speck explains how to make car-dominated downtowns inviting on foot, arguing that walkability is central to a city's health.

title: The Hen Who Dreamed She Could Fly
description: Tired of laying eggs that are taken away, a hen named Sprout plans to escape the coop and hatch a chick of her own.

title: Radiance
description: A human noblewoman and a nonhuman prince agree to an arranged marriage, trying to build a life together across their peoples' mutual revulsion.

title: The City of Brass
description: A Cairo con artist discovers her descent from djinn healers, drawing her into a magical kingdom where her inheritance could help prevent a war.

title: Infinite Powers
description: Steven Strogatz traces calculus through centuries of rivalries and discoveries, explaining how its ideas made modern technology possible.

title: The Disaster Tourist
description: Sent to assess an island's disaster-tourism appeal, Yona discovers a plan to manufacture a catastrophe for business and is asked to help.

title: Better Buses, Better Cities
description: Steven Higashide visits cities improving their buses, showing how better routes, street priorities, and public campaigns can make transit work.

title: Another Now
description: A discovery opens a route toward an alternative society, giving people with clashing politics a chance to confront what a fairer economy might require.

title: Love in Color
description: Bolu Babalola reworks love stories from folklore and mythology, giving their women a greater say in how their romances unfold.

title: Minor Detail
description: A woman in Ramallah investigates the rape and murder of a Palestinian girl by Israeli soldiers decades earlier, drawn to a detail connecting their lives.

title: The Portrait of a Mirror
description: Two affluent couples in New York and Philadelphia share social circles, polished lives, and barely concealed dissatisfaction.

title: How Iceland Changed the World
description: Egill Bjarnason follows Iceland's surprising roles in world history, from Viking arrivals to the French Revolution and Moon landing.

title: The Witch Collector
description: Raina plans to kill the man who took her sister. When a greater threat arrives, the Witch Collector becomes the ally she needs to save her.

title: Love at First Spite
description: Dani plans to spoil her cheating ex's view by building next door, but the architect helping her exact revenge becomes an unexpected distraction.

title: Lavender House
description: After a soap heiress dies, her widow hires a detective to investigate a household where queer residents live openly but keep outsiders at a distance.

title: Judgment at Tokyo
description: Gary J. Bass reconstructs the trial of Japan's wartime leaders, following the struggle to punish atrocities and establish rules for international justice.

title: The Dallergut Dream Department Store
description: New hire Penny learns the workings of a department store that sells dreams, helping visitors shop for adventures, memories, and lost loved ones.

title: Cue the Sun
description: Emily Nussbaum follows the producers, performers, and conflicts that turned reality television from an experiment into an industry.

title: Apartment Women
description: Yojin joins a housing community that expects her to have more children, then grows uneasy about its rules and shared childcare.
